items.title: Gmail OAuth delivery credentials are not configured
items.impact: Source alerts can be generated, deduplicated and packaged, but cannot be delivered by Gmail.
items.exactDependency: GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN or the complete GMAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID + GMAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET + GMAIL_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN set through the existing secret mechanism.

items.title: Source-freshness validator retains the former 841-source Registry hash
items.impact: The implementation checks remain useful, but the standalone historical validator cannot be used as the current global baseline gate after LEGAL-005 raised the Registry to 862.
items.recommendedResolution: Parameterize the authorized baseline or separate implementation-contract validation from mutable library-state validation.

items.title: Earlier Phase 3 apply tools and scoped closure validators contain fixed historical baselines such as 798 and 841
items.impact: They accurately describe their original transaction boundaries but must not be reused as current consolidated validators.
items.recommendedResolution: Keep immutable as transaction evidence; route current validation through the consolidated closeout validator.

items.title: Premium foundation test expects the literal UI text 'Pre-Departure'
items.impact: A broad unrelated UI test can fail after copy/i18n changes despite the LEGAL-003 target contracts passing.
items.recommendedResolution: Assert a stable semantic selector or translation key in a separately authorized product-quality change.

items.title: Legacy FR fire transition wording is less precise than the inclusive effectiveUntil policy
items.impact: The phrase 'atAndAfter20260831' can be read as expiring at the start of the last valid day, while the engine and evidence define 2026-08-31 as inclusive.
items.closureInterpretation: EXPIRY_WARNING on 2026-08-30; valid only within the demonstrated inclusive window through 2026-08-31; EXPIRED_REVIEW_REQUIRED immediately after that window, from 2026-09-01 local date.

items.title: Historical pre-decision packages retain PENDING or blocker states
items.impact: A consumer that ignores state precedence could surface stale status.
items.recommendedResolution: Use final atomic closure/apply records and LEGAL-003 STATE_PRECEDENCE.json as authoritative status; preserve older packages as immutable evidence.

items.title: VDI 2700 Blatt 8.1 remains an external licensed standard for any future normative scope
items.impact: No impact on the approved advisory-only AGM scope. Normative platform/transporter calculations, VDI-specific checklists, compliance verdicts or AI processing require a separate rights and license review.
